adds.title: Gov. David Paterson Executive Order (2009) and Gov. Andrew Cuomo DHR Directive/Regulations (2015-2016)
adds.summary: On December 16, 2009, New York barred state agencies from discriminating on the basis of gender identity in all state-employment matters including hiring, termination, retention, appointment, promotion, tenure, recruitment and compensation, defined gender identity as having or being perceived as having a gender identity, self-image, appearance, behavior or expression whether or not different from sex assigned at birth, and ordered equal-opportunity efforts, consistent guidelines, and swift confidential complaint investigations effective immediately.
